summary: Copies one fixed-size row (140 bytes) from a data table out of the object whose pointer is stored at this+0, and reads a parallel per-row scalar into *a4. Bounds-checked against the row count stored at obj+0x3E14.

operations.description: If a2 < 0 or a2 >= *(*(this) + 15892) (row count field at obj+0x3E14), fail; otherwise proceed. Dereferences this+0 to obtain the table object base.
Row source address = 140 * a2 + *(this) + 916; 140 is the row stride and 916 the data-array offset.
qmemcpy(a3, row source, 0x8C); copies a full 140-byte row into the caller's buffer.
*a4 = *(*(this) + 4 * a2 + 15476); copies the per-row scalar at 4*a2 into the caller's DWORD output.
Return 0 when the row index is out of bounds.
